fixtures.title: Unapproved implementation change
fixtures.headline: REVIEW_REQUIRED
fixtures.blurb: The merchant proxy was approved on implementation A and later upgraded to B: same ABI, same calldata, same price, the payment would still succeed. The pinned report resolves B, the approval pins A, and the controlled signer refuses until a human approves B. No business transaction is signed or broadcast.

fixtures.title: 6-decimal amount on the 18-decimal path
fixtures.headline: BLOCKED
fixtures.blurb: USDC is Arc's gas: one balance, two interfaces (native 18 dec, ERC-20 6 dec). The order is for 0.05 USDC but the transaction sets native value to 50000 instead of 50000000000000000. AMOUNT_SEMANTICS explains why the amount violates the approved order; in this fixture the merchant contract would also reject it. No business transaction is signed or broadcast.

fixtures.title: Approved payment, exact plan, verified outcome
fixtures.headline: CONFIRMED
fixtures.blurb: Baseline matches, order is payable, simulation passes. The runner re-validates at a new block after the fee is confirmed, verifies its own account path, signs exactly the validated plan, persists it, broadcasts, and proves the order reads as paid.

Payment Passport export (format 1.0): portable read-only evidence, no secrets

faucet.note: project testnet funds; one claim per wallet and per client every 24 h; nothing on mainnet

keys.note: pays the project-funded demo runs (≈0.06 USDC each)
creates orders (creation gas) and, on testnet, sends the faucet claims (0.2 USDC each)
relays the check fee (≈0.002 USDC of gas per check)

funds.note: native USDC balances read from the chain by the worker; the thresholds are the operator's; nothing is claimed or moved automatically

access.note: any visitor: anonymous session, own orders, paid checks, wallet execution with after-the-fact plan comparison, recovery, private passports

settlement.note: the check fee is an EIP-3009 authorization relayed by the merchant account, which pays gas in USDC; the business payment is the agent's own transaction with its own gas
